column1: # Model pricing table for 08-set-model-pricing.sh — USD per 1K tokens.
# Tier: "Standard" (geographic / in-region endpoints, us.anthropic.*). This is what
# AWS actually bills for us.* cross-region inference profiles: Price List us-west-2
# offer (published 2026-09-11) `*_standard-Units` SKUs, confirmed against Cost Explorer
# Haiku 4.5 $1.10/$5.50 per 1M. Global profiles (global.*) are 1/1.1 of these.
# Sonnet 5: the launch-time "$3/$15 from Sept 1" increase was cancelled (Anthropic
# pricing docs: "$2/$10 … is now the standard price"). Standard tier = $2.20/$11.00.
# Opus 5.5: list price $4/$20 per 1M (Anthropic pricing docs) x1.1 for the geographic
# endpoint = $4.40/$22.00. Cache read is the exception — Opus 5.5 charges 0.05x the
# input price (every other model here is 0.1x), so it is $0.22/1M, not $0.44.
# Sonnet 5.5: list price $2/$10 per 1M (same as Sonnet 5) x1.1 for the geographic
# endpoint = $2.20/$11.00. Cache read was 0.1x ($0.22/1M); Bedrock cut it 50% from
# 2026-10-07 (pricing page footnote) = $0.11/1M (0.05x, same factor as Opus 5.5).
# Both 08 (apply) and 14 (check) treat this table as the truth. If AWS bills you
# differently (other region/tier, global.* models), edit the rows here first.
# read 0.1x. It also has a long-prompt rate card: when ONE request's prompt (input +
# cache write + cache read tokens) is MORE than 100K, the whole request is billed at
# 5x = $0.55/$2.75 (Price List `*_long_ctx_standard-Units`, checked 2026-10-11).
# The 5m cache write $0.1375/1M = 0.0001375/1K needs 7 decimals — price columns are
# NUMERIC(12,8) since US-19, and this table accepts up to 8.
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   alias  input  output  cache_5m  cache_1h  cache_read
#   long_above  long_input  long_output  long_cache_5m  long_cache_1h  long_cache_read
#   asof  source
# long_*: the second rate card, used when a request's prompt is MORE than long_above
# tokens. All six are numbers, or all six are "-" (no long-prompt rate card).
alias
claude-opus-5-5
claude-sonnet-5-5

column14: aws-price-list-usw2-standard incl. long_ctx (verify in cost explorer)
